invariants.rationale: The method uses profile, so it should not be null at entry.
The method obtains entrySet() from profile.getInputPartitionPathStatMap(), so the map should not be null.
The method calls getOrDefault() on profile.getOutputPartitionPathStatMap(), so the map should not be null.
Map sizes are always non-negative in Java.
If output workload stats are present, its corresponding map should be non-negative in size.
